description: This PHP script handles the server-side logic for processing and executing a mail merge operation within the SuiteCRM platform. It retrieves selected records, initializes the mail merge with the appropriate template, and generates the merged document, then redirects the user to subsequent step.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: Class responsible for performing the mail merge operation, including setting data and field lists, executing the merge, and cleanup.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Sets the list of items to be included in the mail merge.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to be included in the mail merge.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Defines the template files for the merge operation.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge and returns the filename of the generated document.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations after merge is complete.
